data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: 90 total, leaving 10. Next month we’d have either 100 tons or 20 tons—not a guaranteed refill. For future months, each person’s quota could be one-fifth of the stock above a protected 10-ton reserve, rounded down to whole tons. At 20 tons, that means 2 tons each. We can review everyone’s revealed catches and adjust together each month. I’m willing to follow this plan if everyone agrees. John, would you support it?
